name: Main Power Generator Unit 3
description: Primary synchronous generator for turbine unit 3. Connected to grid bus A.111

name: Main Steam Control Valve
description: Controls steam flow from boiler to turbine inlet. Critical safety component.

name: High Pressure Boiler B2
description: Supercritical boiler providing steam for turbine units 2 and 3. Due for annual inspection July 2026.

name: Siemens MCC Panel 4301 - Feeder Drawer 1
description: This is a withdrawable motor control center (MCC) drawer. Working: It contains a Molded Case Circuit Breaker (MCCB), contactor, and thermal overload relay. When activated, the contactor closes the circuit to provide 3-phase power to the connected RO plant high-pressure pump motor. Purpose: To safely distribute low voltage power to individual motor loads in the RO plant, providing overload and short-circuit protection.

name: Siemens MCC Panel 4301 - Feeder Drawer 2
description: Direct-on-line (DOL) motor starter drawer. Working: Uses a combination of breaker and contactor to start RO chemical dosing pumps. Includes auxiliary contacts for DCS monitoring. Purpose: Controls and protects smaller auxiliary motors in the RO water treatment process.

name: Siemens MCC Panel 4302 - Feeder Drawer 1
description: Variable Frequency Drive (VFD) feeder drawer. Working: Supplies regulated power to the VFD which controls the speed of the main RO feed water pump, allowing for variable flow control. Purpose: Main power supply for variable speed control of critical RO pumps, optimizing energy consumption.

name: Siemens MCC Panel 4302 - Feeder Drawer 2
description: Distribution feeder. Working: Provides isolated power to secondary distribution boards within the RO plant building. Includes manual isolation handle on the front panel. Purpose: Safe distribution of power to lighting and auxiliary panels in the RO facility.

name: GCK-System 1 Main ACB
description: Main incoming Air Circuit Breaker (ACB) for the GCK panel. Working: Receives power from the step-down transformer and distributes it to the GCK busbars. Features an electronic trip unit for precise overcurrent, short circuit, and ground fault protection. Purpose: Primary isolation and protection for the entire GCK switchgear lineup.

name: GCK-System 1 Outgoing Feeder 1
description: Outgoing feeder module. Working: Taps power from the main busbar to supply large RO plant loads such as backwash pumps. Purpose: Secondary power distribution and localized fault protection.

name: GCK-System 2 Outgoing Feeder 1
description: Outgoing feeder module. Working: Taps power from the main busbar to supply UV sterilizer units and product water transfer pumps. Purpose: Power distribution for post-treatment equipment in the RO plant.

name: Transformer / Chemical House Incomer
description: Interface panel between the medium voltage transformer and the low voltage switchgear. Working: Houses the main bus ducts, metering CTs/PTs, and surge arresters. The High Voltage / Dangerous sign indicates the presence of primary feed lines. Purpose: To safely transition and meter power from the plant's main transformer to the RO plant MCCs.
